concerns.text: In User Story 2 the lexicon is called “*Attachment Style Lexicon*”, whereas the functional requirements (FR-004) and assumptions refer to it as the “*ECAR Lexicon* (Emotion and Coping in AI Relationships)”. The same instrument should have a single, consistent name throughout the document.

The Assumptions state that if the raw baseline text is missing the pipeline must halt with a “Data Linkage Impossible” or “Text Missing” error, but FR-009 (and FR-004b) require that users lacking raw text be simply excluded from the analysis dataset. These two directives conflict on how missing baseline text should be handled.
